purpose: First source-compiled head blockout using measured anchors and layer taxonomy: skull, face planes, brow/eye band, nose wedge, cheeks, mouth, chin/jaw, ears, and edge language.

source_support.label: NIOSH CDC Stacks: Head-and-Face Anthropometric Survey of U.S. Respirator Users
source_support.support_summary: Primary source for measured adult head and face dimensions such as head length, head breadth, cheek width, jaw width, nose dimensions, and lip length.

source_support.label: National Academies resource copy of Anthrotech report
source_support.support_summary: Accessible report copy used as the source packet for the NIOSH/Anthrotech head and face measurement table.

source_support.label: NASA Anthropometric Source Book
source_support.support_summary: General anthropometry reference for treating body and head dimensions as named measured fields instead of guessed sculpt proportions.

validation_checks: skull envelope exists and is the largest mesh
brow/eye band, nose wedge, and chin/jaw are present as critical read layers
all mesh parts have vertices, faces, material IDs, and source layer IDs
measurement anchors are preserved in the recipe for future tuning
Blender adapter can validate without importing Blender
